page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: banos & Langowoldios enata esset, eam anno M. CCC. LXI, die decollationis Ioannis Baptistae, compositam invenio.

Nota A. Conventus gene-ralis Frisiorum Groningae, relicto Vpstal-lesbomoEodem verò anno M. CCC. LXI. delecti ex Hunesgoniis, Fivelgoniis, Hummerziis, Præfecturâ vetere, & præter hos etiam Ostergoi, Westergoi, Reiderii, Amasani, Broecmerii Groningae con-gressi cum consulibus ac senatu hujus civitatis, pacis & libertatis Frisicae tuendae ergo fancivere, ut rata essent omnia, quae olim in solennibus comitiis gentis ad Vp-stallisbomum fuerant decreta, eademq; sanctè colerentur: Et his addidere alia: ut praetores omnes cum singulis assessoribus suis ac antistitibus aut sacerdotibus quotannis Groningae convenirent ipsis Calendis Iulij, ac de Reip. negotiis deliberarent & constituerent, nec nisi confectis aut definitis negotiis inde discederent sub gravissima poena: ut Selandiis, id est, partibus Frisiae singulis ra-tæ essent consuetudines suæ in electione iudicum; nesocij à sociis proscriptos receptarent, neve idem novis ac insolitis vectigalibus se mutuò onerarent, ut omnes in defendendà libertate, & repellendà notoriâ injuriâ, si necessitas

page.notes: The reference mark "A" of the marginal note is not visible in the text block; I have placed the note at the start of the paragraph where it stands beside the text. The last line is partly cut at the bottom of the scan, and "necessitas" is read from a partly obscured line. The marginal note is printed in small type, hyphenated at line ends; the hyphens are kept as printed. The small-caps numerals are transcribed in capitals. The faint watermark at the bottom right is not printed text and is omitted.
